name: codex-cjk-pdf-viewer
description: Read original PDFs with bundled CJK character maps and fonts in the desktop file panel.

interface.shortDescription: Read PDFs with Japanese text intact
interface.longDescription: A read-only PDF file handler with packaged CMaps and font resources. Opens the original PDF in the desktop thread panel without rewriting or rasterizing the source file.
defaultPrompt: Open this PDF with CJK PDF Viewer.
